comments.author: @marcoalcaraz6986
comments.text: Nice video. I've been to a few, about half, of these places, but think you're missing two that should be near the top of your list. 1) The Lauterbrunnen Valley/Jungfrau/Berner Oberland area, maybe the most spectacular landscape I've seen anywhere, not just in Europe - the Aletsch Glacier is part of the Jungfrau area, but I would say not its most spectacular feature; and 2) Santorini, which besides spectacular is also very iconic with the cubic greek houses and blue domes clinging to the edge of a dark cliff that forms the caldera of the ancient supervolcano, submerged in a deep blue ocean. I mean both of these have human/cultural aspects included in the spectacular natural landscape, but to me they add to the spectacle (like in Meteora, which you do include here).
